fields.description: Save-format magic, little-endian u32 0xBEEFF00D. First word of the 72-byte EEPROM image; verified against samples/baseline.sav in the rev8-logical domain.
fields.evidence: EEPROM word 0 is transferred as one 8-byte unit by FUN_08051274 (read) / FUN_0805132c (write) via the FUN_080511f4 bit-bang driver on 0x0D000000, and compared as a full 8-byte word by FUN_08051410. Raw sav bytes 00 00 00 00 BE EF F0 0D reverse (rev8) to logical 0D F0 EF BE 00 00 00 00, i.e. LE u32 0xBEEFF00D at offset 0; all-zero without rev8.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Game options/flags word stored with the magic in EEPROM word 0 (offsets 0-7 are read, written and verified as a single 8-byte unit). Fresh-save default is 0 (sound on, defaults selected).
fields.evidence: FUN_08051274 / FUN_0805132c move save data in 8-byte EEPROM words and FUN_08051410 verifies a whole word (4 halfwords) at once, so offsets 0-7 form one integrity unit: magic plus this options word. Mutable gameplay/config scalar for live emulator probing.
fields.name: game_options

fields.description: Rank-1 persistent best score (fresh save: 0, no score recorded yet). Scores render as decimal digit strings via FUN_08026d28.
fields.evidence: Save image occupies EEPROM words 0-8 (logical offsets 0x00-0x47; bytes 0x48+ are 0xFF-erased). Each 8-byte EEPROM word is loaded/stored by FUN_08051274 / FUN_0805132c through FUN_080511f4. Score values are formatted for display by the decimal digit renderer FUN_08026d28 (divide helper FUN_080518f4). Mutable gameplay scalar for live emulator probing.
fields.name: high_score_1

fields.description: Rank-1 initials/name cell: 3 packed ASCII initials plus one pad byte (NUL in the fresh save). Paired with high_score_1 in a single 8-byte EEPROM word.
fields.evidence: One FUN_08051274 / FUN_0805132c call moves exactly 8 bytes (offsets 8-15 = word 1), i.e. score plus name cell travel together. NUL-terminated text is fed to the text system char-by-char by FUN_0805163c / FUN_080515dc (formatted by FUN_08051698 via FUN_08002498). All-zero in samples/baseline.sav (no name entered yet).
fields.name: score_initials_1

fields.evidence: EEPROM word 2 (offsets 16-23) moved as an 8-byte unit by FUN_08051274 / FUN_0805132c via FUN_080511f4; score display path is FUN_08026d28 with divide helper FUN_080518f4. Mutable gameplay scalar for live emulator probing.

fields.description: Trailing session/progress block: EEPROM words 6-8 (24 bytes, all zero in the fresh save). Reserved for session progress, play counters or settings the game accumulates after defaults are written.
fields.evidence: Bytes 48-71 are 0x00 (written by the game: erased EEPROM reads 0xFF, and offsets 72+ are still 0xFF) and transfer as three 8-byte words via FUN_08051274 / FUN_0805132c. Address guard FUN_08002428 bounds the valid EEPROM word range. Exact per-byte semantics unrecovered (game-level callers are dispatched through unrecovered tailcall jumptables), hence bytes type.
fields.name: session_progress
